editorial.blurb: A lively all-you-can-eat BBQ and hot pot spot in Chinatown where you grill fresh meats tableside and control the heat to your liking.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the combo deal for $40 to get both BBQ and hot pot — it's the best value. Don't miss the garlic beef and marinated beef short rib, and hit the sauce bar to customize your dips. The staff changes grills frequently (about 8 times), so cleanliness is top-notch.
